description_en: Updates the commerce settings for a phone number
description_zh: 修改号码商业设置状态
kebab_example: aliyun cams update-commerce-setting --cust-space-id 293483938840000 --phone-number 13800000000 --cart-enable true --catalog-visible false --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateCommerceSetting

parameters.help_en: The Space ID of the Independent Software Vendor (ISV) sub-customer
parameters.name: cust_space_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the shopping cart. Valid values:

true: Enable the shopping cart.

false: Disable the shopping cart
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用购物车。取值：

true：启用

false：不启用
parameters.name: cart_enable

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the product catalog. Valid values:

true: Enable the product catalog.

false: Disable the product catalog
parameters.help_zh:
是否显示目录。取值：
true：显示
false：不显示
parameters.name: catalog_visible

Code.description_en:

Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。

返回OK代表请求成功。

Message.description_en: The response message. This parameter is returned when an error occurs

Success.description_en:

true: successful.

false: failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
